The 5-page PDF also has every key date in order (updates, tax returns, payments on account and start dates), a getting-ready checklist, a routine for each quarter and year end, and links to every GOV.UK source. The calendar file adds each date to your calendar with an alert 7 days before.

Who it's for

  • Landlords and sole traders already using MTD since April 2026, or starting in April 2027 or April 2028.
  • Anyone not sure yet whether they need MTD. Page 1 shows the thresholds, and our plain-English guide explains them.
  • Accountants and bookkeepers who want a clean calendar to share with clients.

Questions

Is it really free?

Yes. There's nothing to pay, no card details and no email address needed. The site is paid for by affiliate commissions, which we always label.

How do I get the kit?

Download the PDF and the calendar file from this page. They start downloading straight away.

What is the calendar file?

It adds every deadline to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook, with an alert 7 days before each date. In Google Calendar, open Settings, then Import.

Will you email me reminders?

Not yet. The calendar file already has a 7-day alert for each date. If we later offer optional email reminders, this page will explain how to sign up, and you will not be added to a list automatically.

Is this tax advice?

No. It's general information taken from GOV.UK, with links to every source. Check your own position on GOV.UK or with a qualified adviser.
